pages.text: This page is for creators. Regular players can skip it — the pretty magic circles in-game are drawn with this web tool.$(br2)The Magic Circle Editor ($(#8a5a2b)tools/magic-circle-editor/$()) is a standalone web page for visually designing particle effects; export JSON, drop it into the mod's $(#8a5a2b)magic_circles/$() directory, and it becomes usable in-game.

$(li)$(bold)Shape$(): ring / regular polygon / multi-pointed star, with a $(bold)side count$() (5 makes a five-pointed star).$(li)$(bold)Stroke & density$(): $(#8a5a2b)beads$() distributes particles evenly along the outline, keeping star tips from clumping into a blob; the higher the density, the denser it is.$(li)$(bold)Pulse$(): $(#8a5a2b)pulse_interval$() controls the breathing rhythm of the circle (20 ticks per second).$(li)$(bold)Projection axis$(): $(#8a5a2b)XZ$() lays flat on the ground (normal circles), $(#8a5a2b)Y$() floats vertically (portals, shields).$(li)$(bold)Radius & color$(): the size, and a color gradient from particle birth to death (with alpha support).$(li)$(bold)Curves$(): drag Bezier curves to fine-tune fade-in/out and scaling.
pages.title: What You Can Tune

pages.text: Pick a shape → tune the animation (stroke, pulse, smoothness) → drag the curves → click $(bold)Export Spec$() to export the JSON and drop it into $(#8a5a2b)magic_circles/$(). Done.
pages.title: Quick Workflow

pages.text: $(bold)The exported circle stands upright in-game?$() Switch the projection axis to $(#8a5a2b)XZ$() to lay it flat on the ground; use $(#8a5a2b)Y$() only when you want it to float vertically.$(br2)$(l:wandscape:contents/index_guide)Back to the Guide Index$(/l)
